summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — EDEN.PA +5%, ASM.AS +3%, RMS.PA +3%, KER.PA +3%, ICG.L +3%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (PSON.L -7%, TEP.PA -5%, RHM.DE -3%, PHIA.AS -3%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: PSON.L (-6.66%) — JPMorgan downgraded PSON.L to Neutral from Overweight (ending a 6-yr bullish call) on valuation after a 52-wk high, trimming 2027 EPS 1% on stronger USD hurting its ~65% US-revenue base. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe — appears to be a UK large-cap education/publishing name not covered by the bot's tradable list, so no filter ever got a chance to evaluate the sell-side downgrade signal.

top_movers.catalyst: Continued run-up on BC Partners take-private speculation (first reported mid-June); no fresh confirmed news found for today specifically, but deal-watch flow persists into the Jul 23 earnings date.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe — Edenred is a French mid-cap payments/HR-benefits name, likely excluded as non-core sector/cap-band rather than filtered out technically; M&A rumor-driven grinds also favor pre-rumor positioning over reactive signals.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a small-cap EU deal-speculation watchlist that flags names with >10% cumulative move on unconfirmed M&A press reports, so post-rumor drift (not just the initial gap) becomes tradable within existing risk limits.

top_movers.catalyst: ASML (peer/Euronext semicap) beat Q2 2026 estimates and raised FY26 sales guidance to €43-45B on AI demand, lifting the whole semiconductor-equipment complex incl. ASM.AS
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe entirely — ASM.AS isn't in the tradable list (likely excluded as a non-US/ADR-only or smaller-cap EU semicap name), so no filter even evaluated it; the move was a sympathy rally off a peer's earnings, not ASM's own news.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a peer-correlation trigger: when a same-subsector large-cap (ASML) beats and raises guidance, temporarily admit correlated EU semicap tickers (ASM.AS, BESI.AS) into the universe for same-day momentum screening.

top_movers.catalyst: Sector-wide luxury rally (LVMH +2.8%, Kering +2.3%) after US-Iran ceasefire framework news sent Brent down ~4%, de-risking the sector; no Hermès-specific news.

top_movers.suggestion: Add a CAC40/luxury-sector basket (RMS.PA, MC.PA, KER.PA) to the uk-eu universe with a sector-beta filter so broad geopolitical-driven rallies in this cohort become tradeable, not just single-name catalysts.
